Hi team / Danielle,

Attaching the latest MAP (v3) and the raw benchmark CSV from the 7/5 run. Quick TL;DR from the lab:
- Baseline variant: redwood/rtm-q4_0 (fp16->q4) on p4d-equivalent nodes
- Typical payload: 512 tokens generation, mixed prompt lengths
- Observed: p50 = 140 ms, p95 = 480 ms; sustained throughput ~18 rps (avg request size ~450 tokens -> ~810 tokens/sec aggregate)
- Notable: p95 spikes correlate with cold KV cache misses and small-batch tails (requests that missed the continuous batching window)

As part of this week's MAP checkpoint I'd like us to:
1) Validate the p95 mitigation strategies and pick a canary date for a tuned rollout
2) Agree on the close timeline (customer expects production readiness end of July)
3) Assign owners for QA / perf verification and an exec summary for Danielle / procurement

Please review the attached (acme_map_v3.pdf) and the bench CSV. High-level asks: Marcus — can you run the follow-up tuning matrix (40ms batching window, enable continuous batching, try int8 quant profile) and share expected delta by EOD 7/7? Neha — can you draft the customer-facing summary (1 pager) with the current numbers + risks? Marissa — can you schedule a 30-min checkpoint on 7/12 10:30 PT?

Thanks,

Thanks Olga — quick lab note after running the suggested matrix. Attaching tuning-notes-20260707.md which has the per-run outputs. Short summary:
- Change A: batching window -> 40ms (from 20ms): p50 130 ms, p95 370 ms, throughput +8%
- Change B: continuous batching ON: smooths tail; p95 variance reduced by ~25% (stdev p95 dropped from 42ms to 31ms)
- Change C: int8 quant on the candidate model (q8_opt): slightly higher p50 (145 ms) but p95 improved to 350 ms in combination with batching; memory usage down ~20%
- KV cache warm-start: when we pre-warm prefixes (top-25 prompts) cache hit rate goes from 12%->68% and p95 for those flows drops to ~220 ms

Risks / notes: int8 path needs one more regression pass on quality (small increase in hallucination score on one eval subset). Also the recommended canary should include a short A/B check (5k requests) and a rollback plan if eval metrics degrade.

Actionable next steps (my take):
- Run full int8 quality eval on the 7/8 overnight run (owner: Marcus)
- Produce a canary run plan with metrics & pass/fail thresholds (owner: Marcus)
- Neha: we should include the KV warm-start note in the client summary (it materially improves the p95 for common prompts)

Attachments: tuning-notes-20260707.md
